verses.text: Dem na di words wey Moses speak to all Israel beyond di Jordan for di wilderness, for di Arabah opposite Suph, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
E na 11 days journey from Horeb by di way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
E come be say for di 40th year, for di 11th month, on di first day of di month, Moses speak to di pikin dem of Israel, according to all wey di Lord don give am for commandment to dem,
after e don strike Sihon di king of di Amorites, wey dwell for Heshbon, and Og di king of Bashan, wey dwell for Ashtaroth, for Edrei.
Beyond di Jordan, for di land of Moab, Moses begin to declare dis law, talk,
“Di Lord our God speak to us for Horeb, talk, ‘Una don dwell long enough for dis mountain.

Turn, and take una journey, and go to di hill country of di Amorites, and to all di places near to am, for di Arabah, for di hill country, and for di lowland, and for di South, and by di seacoast, di land of di Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as di great river, di river Euphrates.
Look, I don set di land before una. Go in and possess di land wey di Lord swear to una papa dem, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to dem and to dem seed after dem.’
I speak to una for dat time, talk, ‘I no fit bear una myself alone.
Di Lord una God don multiply una, and look, una dey today as di stars of di sky for multitude.
Di Lord, di God of una papa dem, make una 1,000 times as many as una dey, and bless una, as e don promise una!
How I go bear by myself una cumbrance, and una burden, and una strife?
Take wise men, and understanding, and known among una tribes, and I go make dem heads over una.’
Una answer me, and talk, ‘Di thing wey you don speak dey good for us to do.’

So I take di heads of una tribes, wise men, and known, and make dem heads over una, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers, according to una tribes.
I charge una judges for dat time, talk, ‘Hear di causes between una brothers, and judge righteously between one man and im brother, and di stranger wey dey with am.

Una no go respect persons for judgment. Una go hear di small and di great alike. Una no go be afraid of di face of man, because di judgment na God own. Di cause wey dey too hard for una, una go bring am to me, and I go hear am.’
I command una for dat time all di things wey una go do.
We journey from Horeb, and go through all dat great and terrible wilderness wey una see, by di way to di hill country of di Amorites, as di Lord our God command us. We come to Kadesh Barnea.
I talk to una, ‘Una don come to di hill country of di Amorites, wey di Lord our God dey give us.
Look, di Lord your God don set di land before you. Go up, take possession, as di Lord, di God of your papa dem, don speak to you. No fear, neither dey dismayed.’

Una come near to me, every one of una, and talk, ‘Make we send men before us, so that dem go search di land for us, and bring us word again of di way by wey we must go up, and di cities into wey we go come.’
Di saying dey good for my eyes, and I take 12 men of una, one man for each tribe.
Dem turn and go up into di hill country, and come to di valley of Eshcol, and spy am out.
Dem take of di fruit of di land for dem hands, and bring am down to us, and bring us word again, and talk, ‘Na one good land wey di Lord our God dey give us.’
Yet una no go up, but rebel against di commandment of di Lord una God.
Una murmur for una tents, and talk, ‘Because di Lord hate us, e don bring us out of di land of Egypt, to deliver us into di hand of di Amorites, to destroy us.

Where we go go up? Our brothers don make our heart melt, say di people dey greater and taller pass us, di cities dey great and fortified up to heaven, and say moreover dem see di descendants of di Anakim dere.’
I talk to una, ‘No dey terrified, neither dey afraid of dem.
Di Lord una God, wey go before una, e go fight for una, according to all wey e do for una for Egypt before una eyes,
and for di wilderness, wia you see how di Lord your God carry you, as one man carry im pikin, for all di way wey una go, until una come to dis place.’
Yet for all dis una no believe di Lord una God,
wey go before una for di way, to seek out una place to pitch una tents, for fire by night, to show una by wetin way una must go, and for cloud by day.
Di Lord hear di voice of una words, and e dey angry, and swear, talk,
‘Surely none of dem men of dis evil generation go see di good land wey I swear to give to una papa dem,
except Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh. E go see am, and to am I go give di land wey e don tread upon, and to im pikin dem, because e don follow di Lord fully.’
Also di Lord dey angry with me for una sakes, talk, ‘You too no go go in dere.
Joshua di pikin of Nun, wey stand before you, e go go in dere. Encourage am, because e go cause Israel to inherit am.
Moreover una little ones, wey una talk go be one prey, and una pikin dem, wey today no know good or evil, dem go go in dere, and to dem I go give am, and dem go possess am.
But as for una, turn, and go into di wilderness by di way to di Red Sea.’

Una answer and talk to me, ‘We don sin against di Lord. We go go up and fight, according to all wey di Lord our God command us.’ Every man of una gird on im weapons of war, and dey ready to go up into di hill country.
Di Lord talk to me, ‘Tell dem make dem no go up, neither fight, because I no dey among dem, so that dem no go dey struck before dem enemies.’
So I speak to una, and una no listen, but una rebel against di commandment of di Lord, and dey presumptuous, and go up into di hill country.
Di Amorites, wey dwell for dat hill country, come out against una, and chase una, as bees do, and beat una down for Seir, even to Hormah.
Una return and weep before di Lord, but di Lord no listen to una voice, nor give ear to una.
So una stay for Kadesh many days, according to di days wey una stay dere.”
“We turn, and journey into di wilderness by di way to di Red Sea, as di Lord speak to me. We go around Mount Seir many days.
Di Lord speak to me, talk,
‘Una don go around dis mountain long enough. Turn north.
Command di people: Una go pass through di border of una brothers di pikin dem of Esau, wey dwell for Seir, and dem go dey afraid of una. Take good heed to yourselves.
No contend with dem, because I no go give una of dem land, no, not so much as one foot breadth, because I don give Mount Seir to Esau for possession.
Una go purchase food of dem for money, so that una go eat. Una go also buy water of dem for money, so that una go drink.
Because di Lord your God don bless you for all di work of your hand. E don know your walking through dis great wilderness. Dis 40 years di Lord your God don dey with you. You don lack nothing.’
So we pass by from our brothers di pikin dem of Esau, wey dwell for Seir, from di way of di Arabah, from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turn and pass by di way of di wilderness of Moab.
Di Lord talk to me, ‘No harass Moab, neither contend with dem for battle, because I no go give you of im land for possession, because I don give Ar to di pikin dem of Lot for possession.’
Di Emim live dere before, one people great, and many, and tall as di Anakim.
Dem too dey counted as Rephaim, like di Anakim, but di Moabites call dem Emim.

Di Horites too live for Seir before, but di pikin dem of Esau drive dem out, and destroy dem from before dem, and live for dem place, as Israel do to di land of im possession, wey di Lord give to dem.
‘Now rise up, and cross di brook Zered.’ We cross di brook Zered.
Di days wey we come from Kadesh Barnea, until we cross di brook Zered, na 38 years, until all di generation of di men of war dey consumed from among di camp, as di Lord swear to dem.
Moreover di hand of di Lord dey against dem, to destroy dem from among di camp, until dem dey consumed.
E come be say, when all di men of war dey consumed and dead from among di people,
di Lord speak to me, talk,
‘You go pass over Ar, di border of Moab, dis day.

When you come near over against di pikin dem of Ammon, no harass dem, nor contend with dem, because I no go give you any of di land of di pikin dem of Ammon for possession, because I don give am to di pikin dem of Lot for possession.’
Dat too dey counted as one land of Rephaim. Rephaim dey live dere before, but di Ammonites call dem Zamzummim,
one people great, and many, and tall as di Anakim, but di Lord destroy dem before dem, and dem drive dem out, and live for dem place,
as e do for di pikin dem of Esau, wey live for Seir, when e destroy di Horites from before dem, and dem drive dem out, and live for dem place even to dis day.
As for di Avvim, wey live for villages as far as Gaza, di Caphtorim, wey come out of Caphtor, destroy dem, and live for dem place.
‘Rise up, take una journey, and pass over di valley of Arnon. Look, I don give into your hand Sihon di Amorite, king of Heshbon, and im land. Begin to possess am, and contend with am for battle.
Dis day I go begin to put di dread of you and di fear of you on di peoples wey dey under di whole sky, wey go hear di report of you, and go tremble, and dey in anguish because of you.’
I send messengers out of di wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, talk,
‘Make I pass through your land. I go go along by di highway. I no go turn aside to di right hand nor to di left.
Una go sell me food for money, so that I go eat, and give me water for money, so that I go drink. Only make I pass through on my feet,
as di pikin dem of Esau wey dwell for Seir, and di Moabites wey dwell for Ar, do to me, until I pass over di Jordan into di land wey di Lord our God dey give us.’
But Sihon king of Heshbon no go let us pass by am, because di Lord your God harden im spirit, and make im heart obstinate, so that e go deliver am into your hand, as e dey today.
Di Lord talk to me, ‘Look, I don begin to deliver Sihon and im land before you. Begin to possess, so that you go inherit im land.’
Sihon come out against us, e and all im people, to battle for Jahaz.
Di Lord our God deliver am up before us, and we strike am, and im pikin man dem, and all im people.
We take all im cities for dat time, and utterly destroy every city, di men, and di women, and di little ones. We leave none remaining.
Only di livestock we take for prey to ourselves, with di plunder of di cities wey we take.
From Aroer, wey dey by di edge of di valley of Arnon, and from di city wey dey di valley, even to Gilead, no city dey too high for us. Di Lord our God deliver up all before us.
Only to di land of di pikin dem of Ammon you no come near, nor to any place of di valley of di Jabbok, nor to di cities of di hill country, nor to wherever di Lord our God forbid us.”
“We turn, and go up by di way to Bashan. Og di king of Bashan come out against us, e and all im people, to battle for Edrei.
Di Lord talk to me, ‘No fear am, because I don deliver am, and all im people, and im land, into your hand. You go do to am as you do to Sihon king of di Amorites, wey dwell for Heshbon.’
So di Lord our God deliver into our hand Og too, di king of Bashan, and all im people. We strike am until none remain to am.
We take all im cities for dat time. Dere no dey city wey we no take from dem: 60 cities, all di region of Argob, di kingdom of Og for Bashan.
All dem cities dey fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, besides di unwalled towns, plenty.
We utterly destroy dem, as we do to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every city, di men, women, and little ones.
But all di livestock, and di plunder of di cities, we take for prey to ourselves.
We take di land for dat time out of di hand of di two kings of di Amorites wey dey beyond di Jordan, from di valley of Arnon to Mount Hermon.
Di Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and di Amorites call am Senir.
We take all di cities of di plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of di kingdom of Og for Bashan.

Because only Og king of Bashan remain of di remnant of di Rephaim. Look, im bed na one bed of iron. E no dey for Rabbah of di pikin dem of Ammon? Im length na nine cubits, and im width four cubits, after di cubit of one man.
We possess dis land for dat time. From Aroer, wey dey by di valley of Arnon, and half di hill country of Gilead, and di cities of am, I give to di Reubenites and to di Gadites.
Di rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, di kingdom of Og, I give to di half tribe of Manasseh. All di region of Argob, with all Bashan, dem dey call am di land of Rephaim.
Jair di pikin of Manasseh take all di region of Argob, to di border of di Geshurites and di Maacathites, and call dem, even Bashan, after im own name, Havvoth Jair, to dis day.
I give Gilead to Machir.
To di Reubenites and to di Gadites I give from Gilead even to di valley of Arnon, di middle of di valley as border, and to di river Jabbok, di border of di pikin dem of Ammon,
and di Arabah, with di Jordan as border, from Chinnereth even to di sea of di Arabah, di Salt Sea, under di slopes of Pisgah eastward.
I command una for dat time, talk, ‘Di Lord una God don give una dis land to possess am. Una go pass over armed before una brothers di pikin dem of Israel, all wey fit for war.
But una wives, and una little ones, and una livestock, wey I know say una get much livestock, go stay for una cities wey I don give una,
until di Lord give rest to una brothers, as to una, and dem too possess di land wey di Lord una God give dem beyond di Jordan. After dat una go return every man to im possession, wey I don give una.’
I command Joshua for dat time, talk, ‘Your eyes don see all wey di Lord your God don do to dem two kings. Na so di Lord go do to all di kingdoms wia you go pass.
Una no go fear dem, because di Lord una God na im dey fight for una.’
I plead with di Lord for dat time, talk,
‘Lord God, you don begin to show your servant your greatness, and your mighty hand. Because wetin god dey for heaven or for earth wey fit do like your works, and like your mighty acts?
Make I go over, and see di good land wey dey beyond di Jordan, dat good hill country, and Lebanon.’
But di Lord dey angry with me for una sakes, and no listen to me. Di Lord talk to me, ‘Make e enough for you. Speak no more to me of dis matter.
Go up to di top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes, because you no go go over dis Jordan.
But charge Joshua, and encourage am, and strengthen am, because e go go over before dis people, and e go cause dem to inherit di land wey you go see.’
So we stay for di valley opposite Beth Peor.”
“Now, Israel, listen to di statutes and to di ordinances, wey I teach una, to do dem, so that una go live, and go in and possess di land wey di Lord, di God of una papa dem, dey give una.
Una no go add to di word wey I command una, neither go una take away from am, so that una go keep di commandments of di Lord una God wey I command una.
Una eyes don see wetin di Lord do because of Baal Peor, because all di men wey follow Baal Peor, di Lord your God don destroy dem from among una.
But una wey hold fast to di Lord una God dey alive every one of una today.
Look, I don teach una statutes and ordinances, even as di Lord my God command me, so that una go do so for di land wia una dey go in to possess am.
Keep dem and do dem, because dis na una wisdom and una understanding for di sight of di peoples, wey go hear all dem statutes, and talk, ‘Surely dis great nation na wise and understanding people.’
Because wetin great nation dey, wey get God so near to dem as di Lord our God dey, whenever we call upon am?
Wetin great nation dey, wey get statutes and ordinances so righteous as all dis law, wey I set before una today?

Only take heed to yourself, and keep your soul diligently, so that you no go forget di things wey your eyes don see, and so that dem no go depart from your heart all di days of your life. Make dem known to your pikin dem and your grandpikin dem:

di day wey you stand before di Lord your God for Horeb, when di Lord talk to me, ‘Gather di people to me, and I go make dem hear my words, so that dem go learn to fear me all di days wey dem live upon di earth, and so that dem go teach dem pikin dem.’
Una come near and stand under di mountain. Di mountain burn with fire to di heart of heaven, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
Di Lord speak to una out of di middle of di fire. Una hear di sound of words, but una see no form. Only una hear one voice.
E declare to una im covenant, wey e command una to perform, even di Ten Commandments. E write dem on two tablets of stone.
Di Lord command me for dat time to teach una statutes and ordinances, so that una go do dem for di land wey una go over to possess.
Take good heed to yourselves, because una see no form for di day wey di Lord speak to una for Horeb out of di middle of di fire,
so that una no go corrupt yourselves, and make una one carved image, di form of any figure, di likeness of male or female,
di likeness of any animal wey dey di earth, di likeness of any winged bird wey fly for di sky,
di likeness of anything wey creep on di ground, di likeness of any fish wey dey di waters under di earth.

Make una no lift up una eyes to heaven, and when una see di sun, di moon, and di stars, all di army of heaven, una dey drawn away and worship dem, and serve dem, wey di Lord una God don allocate to all di peoples under di whole heaven.
But di Lord don take una, and bring una out of di iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to am one people of inheritance, as una dey today.
Moreover di Lord dey angry with me for una sakes, and swear say I no go go over di Jordan, and say I no go go in to dat good land, wey di Lord your God dey give you for inheritance.
But I must die for dis land. I must no go over di Jordan, but una go go over, and possess dat good land.
Take heed to yourselves, so that una no go forget di covenant of di Lord una God, wey e make with una, and make una one carved image, di form of anything wey di Lord your God don forbid you.
Because di Lord your God na one consuming fire, one jealous God.

When you don beget pikin dem, and grandpikin dem, and una don dey long for di land, and una corrupt yourselves, and make one carved image, di form of anything, and do wetin dey evil for di sight of di Lord your God, to provoke am to anger,

I call heaven and earth to witness against una today, say una go soon utterly perish from off di land wey una go over di Jordan to possess. Una no go prolong una days upon am, but una go utterly dey destroyed.
Di Lord go scatter una among di peoples, and una go dey left few in number among di nations, wia di Lord go lead una.
Dere una go serve gods, di work of men hands, wood and stone, wey no fit see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
But from dere una go seek di Lord your God, and una go find am, when you search after am with all your heart and with all your soul.
When you dey for tribulation, and all dem things don come on you, for di latter days una go return to di Lord your God, and listen to im voice.
Because di Lord your God na merciful God. E no go fail you, neither destroy you, nor forget di covenant of una papa dem wey e swear to dem.

Ask now of di days wey don pass, wey dey before you, since di day wey God create man upon di earth, and ask from di one end of heaven to di other, whether any such thing as dis great thing don happen, or don dey heard like am.
Any people don hear di voice of God speaking out of di middle of di fire, as you don hear, and live?

Or God don try to go take for imself one nation from di middle of another nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by one mighty hand, and by one stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all wey di Lord your God do for una for Egypt before your eyes?
To you e show am, so that you go know say di Lord, e na God. Dere no dey any other besides am.
Out of heaven e make you hear im voice, so that e go instruct you. On earth e show you im great fire, and you hear im words out of di middle of di fire.
Because e love your papa dem, na why e choose dem seed after dem, and bring you out with im presence, with im mighty power, out of Egypt,
to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier pass you, to bring you in, to give you dem land for inheritance, as e dey today.
Know therefore today, and consider am for your heart, say di Lord, e na God for heaven above and upon di earth beneath. Dere no dey other.

You go keep im statutes, and im commandments, wey I command you today, so that e go go well with you, and with your pikin dem after you, and so that you go prolong your days upon di land wey di Lord your God dey give you, forever.”
Moses set apart three cities beyond di Jordan toward di sunrise,
so that di manslayer go flee dere, wey kill im neighbour unintentionally, and no hate am for time past, and dat by fleeing to one of dem cities e go live:
Bezer for di wilderness, for di plain country, for di Reubenites. Ramoth for Gilead, for di Gadites. And Golan for Bashan, for di Manassites.
Dis na di law wey Moses set before di pikin dem of Israel.
Dem na di testimonies, and di statutes, and di ordinances, wey Moses speak to di pikin dem of Israel, when dem come out of Egypt,
beyond di Jordan, for di valley opposite Beth Peor, for di land of Sihon king of di Amorites, wey dwell for Heshbon, wey Moses and di pikin dem of Israel strike when dem come out of Egypt.
Dem possess im land, and di land of Og king of Bashan, di two kings of di Amorites, wey dey beyond di Jordan toward di sunrise,
from Aroer, wey dey by di edge of di valley of Arnon, even to Mount Sirion, wey na Hermon,
and all di Arabah beyond di Jordan eastward, even to di sea of di Arabah, under di slopes of Pisgah.
Moses call all Israel, and talk to dem, “Hear, Israel, di statutes and di ordinances wey I speak for una ears today, so that una go learn dem, and observe to do dem.
Di Lord our God make one covenant with us for Horeb.
Di Lord no make dis covenant with our papa dem, but with us, even us, wey all dey here alive today.
Di Lord speak with una face to face for di mountain out of di middle of di fire,
while I stand between di Lord and una for dat time, to show una di word of di Lord, because una dey afraid because of di fire, and una no go up into di mountain. E talk,
‘I na di Lord your God, wey bring you out of di land of Egypt, out of di house of bondage.
You go get no other gods before me.
You no go make for yourself one carved image, or any likeness of anything wey dey heaven above, or wey dey di earth beneath, or wey dey di water under di earth.

You no go bow yourself down to dem, nor serve dem, because I, di Lord your God, na one jealous God, visiting di iniquity of di papa dem on di pikin dem, and on di third and on di fourth generation of dem wey hate me,
and showing lovingkindness to thousands, to dem wey love me and keep my commandments.
You no go take di name of di Lord your God in vain, because di Lord no go hold am guiltless wey take im name in vain.
Observe di Sabbath day, to keep am holy, as di Lord your God command you.
Six days you go labour, and do all your work,

but di seventh day na Sabbath to di Lord your God. For am you no go do any work, you, nor your pikin man, nor your pikin woman, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger wey dey inside your gates, so that your male servant and your female servant go rest as well as you.

You go remember say you dey one servant for di land of Egypt, and di Lord your God bring you out from dere by one mighty hand and by one outstretched arm. Therefore di Lord your God command you to keep di Sabbath day.
Honour your papa and your mama, as di Lord your God command you, so that your days go dey long, and so that e go go well with you, for di land wey di Lord your God dey give you.
You no go murder.
Neither go you commit adultery.
Neither go you steal.
Neither go you give false testimony against your neighbour.
Neither go you covet your neighbour wife. Neither go you desire your neighbour house, im field, or im male servant, or im female servant, im ox, or im donkey, or anything wey be your neighbour own.’

Dem words di Lord speak to all your assembly for di mountain out of di middle of di fire, of di cloud, and of di thick darkness, with one great voice, and e add no more. E write dem on two tablets of stone, and give dem to me.
E come be say, when una hear di voice out of di middle of di darkness, while di mountain dey burn with fire, una come near to me, even all di heads of una tribes, and una elders.
Una talk, ‘Look, di Lord our God don show us im glory and im greatness, and we don hear im voice out of di middle of di fire. We don see today say God dey speak with man, and e dey live.
Now therefore why we go die? Because dis great fire go consume us. If we hear di voice of di Lord our God any more, we go die.
Because who dey among all flesh, wey don hear di voice of di living God speaking out of di middle of di fire, as we don, and live?
Go near, and hear all wey di Lord our God go talk, and tell us all wey di Lord our God talk to you, and we go hear am, and do am.’
Di Lord hear di voice of una words, when una speak to me. Di Lord talk to me, ‘I don hear di voice of di words of dis people, wey dem don speak to you. Dem don well say all dat dem don speak.
Oh say dem get one heart like dat for dem, to fear me, and keep all my commandments always, so that e go go well with dem, and with dem pikin dem forever!
Go tell dem make dem return to dem tents.
But as for you, stand here by me, and I go speak to you all di commandment, and di statutes, and di ordinances, wey you go teach dem, so that dem go do dem for di land wey I give dem to possess.’
Una go observe to do therefore as di Lord una God don command una. Una no go turn aside to di right hand or to di left.
Una go waka for all di way wey di Lord una God don command una, so that una go live, and that e go go well with una, and that una go prolong una days for di land wey una go possess.”
“Now dis na di commandment, di statutes, and di ordinances, wey di Lord una God command to teach una, so that una go do dem for di land wia una go over to possess am,

so that you go fear di Lord your God, to keep all im statutes and im commandments, wey I command you, you, and your pikin, and your grandpikin, all di days of your life, and so that your days go dey prolonged.

Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do am, so that e go go well with you, and so that una go increase greatly, as di Lord, di God of your papa dem, don promise you, for one land wey dey flow with milk and honey.
Hear, Israel: di Lord our God, di Lord na one.
You go love di Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.
Dem words, wey I command you today, go dey for your heart.
You go teach dem diligently to your pikin dem, and go talk of dem when you sit for your house, and when you waka by di way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
You go bind dem for one sign on your hand, and dem go be as frontlets between your eyes.
You go write dem on di door posts of your house, and on your gates.
E go come be say, when di Lord your God don bring you into di land wey e swear to your papa dem, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities, wey you no build,
and houses full of all good things, wey you no fill, and cisterns dug out, wey you no dig, vineyards and olive trees, wey you no plant, and you don eat and dey full,
beware, so that you no go forget di Lord, wey bring you out of di land of Egypt, out of di house of bondage.
You go fear di Lord your God. Na am you go serve, and na by im name you go swear.
You no go go after other gods, of di gods of di peoples wey dey round you,
because di Lord your God for di middle of you na one jealous God, so that di anger of di Lord your God no go dey kindled against you, and e destroy you from off di surface of di earth.
You no go test di Lord your God, as una test am for Massah.
You go diligently keep di commandments of di Lord your God, and im testimonies, and im statutes, wey e don command you.
You go do wetin dey right and good for di sight of di Lord, so that e go go well with you, and so that you go go in and possess di good land wey di Lord swear to your papa dem,
to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as di Lord don speak.
When your pikin ask you for time to come, talk, ‘Wetin di testimonies, and di statutes, and di ordinances mean, wey di Lord our God don command una?’
you go tell your pikin, ‘We dey Pharaoh servants for Egypt, and di Lord bring us out of Egypt with one mighty hand.
Di Lord show signs and wonders, great and awesome, on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all im house, before our eyes.
E bring us out from dere, so that e go bring us in, to give us di land wey e swear to our papa dem.
Di Lord command us to do all dem statutes, to fear di Lord our God, for our good always, so that e go keep us alive, as e dey today.
E go be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all dis commandment before di Lord our God, as e don command us.’”

“When di Lord your God go bring you into di land wia you go in to possess am, and go cast out many nations before you, di Hittites, di Girgashites, di Amorites, di Canaanites, di Perizzites, di Hivites, and di Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier pass you,
and when di Lord your God go deliver dem up before you, and you go strike dem, you go utterly destroy dem. You no go make any covenant with dem, nor show mercy to dem.
You no go make marriages with dem. Your pikin woman you no go give to dem pikin man, and dem pikin woman you no go take for your pikin man.
Because e go turn away your pikin dem from following me, so that dem go serve other gods. Di anger of di Lord go dey kindled against una, and e go destroy you quickly.
But na so una go deal with dem: una go break down dem altars, and dash in pieces dem pillars, and cut down dem Asherim, and burn dem engraved images with fire.
Because you na one holy people to di Lord your God. Di Lord your God don choose you to be one people for im own possession, above all peoples wey dey upon di surface of di earth.
Di Lord no set im love on una, nor choose una, because una dey more in number pass any people, because una na di fewest of all peoples,

but because di Lord love una, and because e keep di oath wey e swear to una papa dem, di Lord don bring una out with one mighty hand, and redeem una out of di house of bondage, from di hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
Know therefore say di Lord your God, e na God, di faithful God, wey keep covenant and lovingkindness to 1,000 generations with dem wey love am and keep im commandments,
and repay dem wey hate am to dem face, to destroy dem. E no go be slack to am wey hate am. E go repay am to im face.
You go therefore keep di commandment, and di statutes, and di ordinances, wey I command you today, to do dem.
E go come be say, because una listen to dem ordinances, and keep and do dem, di Lord your God go keep with you di covenant and di lovingkindness wey e swear to your papa dem.

E go love you, and bless you, and multiply you. E go also bless di fruit of your womb, and di fruit of your ground, your grain, and your new wine, and your oil, di increase of your livestock, and di young of your flock, for di land wey e swear to your papa dem to give you.
You go dey blessed above all peoples. No male or female go dey barren among una, or among your livestock.
Di Lord go take away from you all sickness, and e go put none of di evil diseases of Egypt, wey you know, on you, but e go lay dem on all dem wey hate you.
You go consume all di peoples wey di Lord your God go deliver to you. Your eye no go pity dem, neither go you serve dem gods, because dat go be one snare to you.
If you talk for your heart, ‘Dem nations pass me. How I go dispossess dem?’
you no go dey afraid of dem. You go well remember wetin di Lord your God do to Pharaoh, and to all Egypt:

di great trials wey your eyes see, di signs, di wonders, di mighty hand, and di stretched out arm, wey di Lord your God bring you out by. Na so di Lord your God go do to all di peoples wey you dey afraid of.
Moreover di Lord your God go send di hornet among dem, until dem wey remain, and hide demself from you, dey destroyed.
You no go dey terrified of dem, because di Lord your God dey among you, one great and awesome God.
Di Lord your God go cast out dem nations before you by little and little. You no go consume dem at once, otherwise di animals of di field go increase on you.
But di Lord your God go deliver dem up before you, and go destroy dem with one great destruction, until dem dey destroyed.
E go deliver dem kings into your hand, and you go make dem name perish from under heaven. No man go dey able to stand before you, until you don destroy dem.

Di engraved images of dem gods una go burn with fire. You no go covet di silver or di gold wey dey on dem, nor take am for yourself, so that you no go dey snared by am, because e na abomination to di Lord your God.
You no go bring one abomination into your house, and become one devoted thing like am. You go utterly detest am, and you go utterly abhor am, because e na one devoted thing.”
